commuteAccess.summary: Etapp 7 has no bus directly at either shelter endpoint. Best fixed-route candidates are Odensviholm for the Kyrksjön start, Dalhem kyrka as a strong mid-stage access/bailout, and Lilla Dalhem as the closest practical near-end exit for Björndalen/Stora Vrången. Service is rural and must be checked by date.

start.caveats: Closest KLT stop-area candidate to the Kyrksjön shelter start, but actual walking route may be longer than straight-line distance. Line 30 is sparse/rural and must be checked by date.
Useful only as alternate Odensvi village access. Treat as off-route/start-area context rather than the trailhead.

midpoints.confidence: high for coordinates and access role; medium for schedule usefulness
midpoints.caveats: Best mid-stage bailout/access point. Verify current stop direction, timetable, and walking approach before publication.

end.caveats: Closest practical near-end exit from the late-stage route, not a stop at Björndalen shelter itself. Walking route/safety from the shelter and timetable must be verified.
Longer and weaker alternative. Use only if Lilla Dalhem is not suitable after trip-date planning.

campingAndFire.summary: Main overnight infrastructure is shelter-based: Kyrksjön at the start, Ticka at Holmsjön, and Björndalen at the finish. No on-route waste facility was found. Fire and tenting rules must account for current fire bans and Stora Vrången reserve restrictions near the finish.

fireRules.rule: Fire-ban status is dynamic and must be checked immediately before publication/travel. Query on 2026-04-29 showed no fire ban for Västervik, but that should not be stored as durable trail data.
Within Stora Vrången, fires are allowed only at designated places or in a carried grill/stove; do not damage living/dead trees or branches.

campingRules.rule: Do not tent more than one day in the same place inside the reserve.

waste.notes: Trail-owner information says there is no waste collection on the trail; hikers should carry out waste.

currentness.status: No Etapp 7-specific acute closure or obstruction found on the trail-owner acute information page on 2026-04-29.

maintenance.notes: Trail-owner Lednyheter page says all 43 care sections are assigned except Dalhems kyrka to Björndalens vindskydd, which is the final part of Etapp 7. This conflicts with/qualifies the existence of a 2026 section-responsibility PDF listing sub-sections and should be treated as a currentness caveat.

dogsAndLivestock.dogRule: On 2026-04-29, the annual March 1-August 20 wildlife-sensitive period is active; dogs must be under such control that they cannot run loose where wildlife exists, which in most cases means leash. Stora Vrången and Risebo reserve rules require leash.

hunting.notes: Länsstyrelsen Kalmar's 2026 lynx licence hunt ran 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 and was over by the 2026-04-29 access date. General Naturvårdsverket guidance says Jakt pågår signs do not prohibit access but visitors should avoid disturbing hunting.
